questions.prompt: What does a loop invariant express?
questions.answer: A property that stays true after each loop iteration.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: invariant — Condition maintained throughout a loop.
boundary test — Tests around value/size limits.
time complexity — Growth in work as input increases.

blocks.title: State the precondition
blocks.text: The input must be sorted; equal values then appear consecutively.

blocks.title: Trace the invariant
blocks.text: Start with one distinct value for a nonempty array. Each change from previous value adds one.

blocks.title: Evaluate and test
blocks.text: The algorithm scans once O(n) time, O(1) extra space; test empty, all equal and all distinct inputs.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Duplicates do not increment the counter because each equals the preceding element.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the method
blocks.text: Only changes to five and seven increment count; result is three distinct values.
